name: openbb_fixedincome_treasury_auctions
description:
US Treasury auction results (security type, CUSIP, dates, high yield or rate, bid-to-cover and more) from TreasuryDirect through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.government.treasury_auctions).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts government_us only; schema default federal_reserve (also rejected), but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); government_us needs no key.
Market yields: av_treasury_yield, fred_10yr_treasury. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "government_us"}
